item.title: LARQ Bottle PureVis 2
item.description: The LARQ Bottle PureVis 2 combines self cleaning technology, water filtration and hydration tracking in one smart insulated bottle designed for everyday use. Built with UV C LED purification, it helps keep both the water and the interior clean while reducing bacteria growth without using toxic materials.
